data.name: Wish Peddler Gift
data.description: Once per day as a full-round action, you can duplicate the effect of a witch spell of a spell level lower than your manifestation level. This spell cannot have a material or focus component costing more than 1 gp or a casting time longer than 1 standard action. The spell's effect must fulfill, in part or in whole, a wish verbally stated by a humanoid creature you can hear (other than yourself ).
